capabilities: Surface directly relevant notes in a Related stream while writing
Suggest diverse cross-topic candidates in a Discover stream
Retrieve candidates with hybrid vector and full-text search plus a cross-encoder reranker
Index the vault incrementally into a local LanceDB store
Preview matched notes and jump to the exact matched passage
extras: Desktop only (mobile code exists but is unsupported). First run downloads local embedding and reranker models from Hugging Face; the reranker model is roughly 2.3 GB and needs extra memory. Remote mode sends note contents to the configured address and requires a SEMANTIX_API_TOKEN. The Python engine ships separately and must be obtained and built from the project source repository.
intentEvidence: Disable the older obsidian-semantix plugin before enabling this semantix plugin: both register the same legacy view type
problem: Obsidian's built-in search and backlinks do not surface semantically similar or cross-topic notes automatically while writing.

summary: Local semantic retrieval plugin that shows a dual-stream sidebar of related and diverse notes while you write, powered by a companion Python engine.
